is_anopheles.evidence: Tested against Anopheles gambiae s.s., Anopheles coluzzii, and Anopheles funestus (Page 1, 2).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study evaluates the mosquitocidal activity of isoxazoline compounds via membrane feeding bioassays. It mentions rdl, kdr, and ace-1 in the introduction/discussion in context, but does not perform genotyping or report marker frequencies for any target resistance markers.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No resistance marker genotyping was performed or reported.

african_field_population.evidence: All mosquito strains evaluated were established insectary colonies (Kisumu, Goden, An. funestus s.s., and Ae. aegypti Bora Bora) maintained at CNRFP insectary in Burkina Faso (Page 6, Methods).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary empirical research paper evaluating the insecticidal effect of isoxazolines.

sub_country_location.evidence: Experiments conducted at CNRFP in Ouagadougou, Burkina Faso (Page 1, 6).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Laboratory study received in October 2024 and published in 2025 (Page 6).

supplement.evidence: No supplementary data needed; paper contains no marker genotyping.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the mosquitocidal activity of three isoxazoline derivatives (fluralaner, afoxolaner, and lotilaner) against laboratory-reared colonies of Anopheles gambiae s.s., An. coluzzii, An. funestus, and Aedes aegypti, as well as the potential impact of sugar diets and antibiotic treatment. The paper reports bioassay efficacy (IC50 values) but does not genotype target insecticide resistance markers or sample field mosquito populations, rendering it ineligible.
exclusion_reasons: Does not report genotyping or frequency data for target insecticide resistance markers.
Does not test extractable genotype data.
Does not test field-caught or wild-collected African mosquito populations (uses established insectary colonies).
